response: Listen, an ICE agent stepped in at JFK International Airport in New York on Thursday to help a baby who stopped breathing in a crowded TSA line with his family, and the Department of Homeland Security released footage of the agent noticing the issue and starting to assist. It's good that quick action was taken, but this really exposes the structural inequalities built into our systems. Those packed, stressful lines hit marginalized communities the hardest because of underfunding and policies that fail to prioritize the well-being of vulnerable families. We need serious institutional reforms to tackle these problems and safeguard those most at risk.
